title: Clean up ScriptTextEditor lazy loading

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/124489
- Supersedes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/115662

Removed the partially initialized state of ScriptTextEditor, it is now fine to call `validate_script` at any time. Notably it did not fully set up the gutters, so it has caused errors like `Index p_gutter = -1 is out of bounds (gutters.size() = 4).` multiple times in the past. And it caused other issues like https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/110946.

It's not very effective recently either, some refactors moved things out of `_enable_code_editor`, and most of the benefits have been lost. Most things are created in the constructor, so not connecting some signals and not adding a couple of the children is only a little benefit. The actual things that take the longest are creating ColorPicker and other Windows.
I changed these to be individually lazily created.

Average of ScriptEditor `set_window_layout` with 200 scripts, 5 runs, dev build:
master (4d10419) 13.329s
without separate `_enable_code_editor` 14.593s
PR 5.833s
2.29x speedup

## Additional information

Makes the Context menu, Go to Line Popup, ColorPicker, ConnectionInfoDialog, and ScriptEditorQuickOpen all lazy initialized, they are only created when they are actually used.

ScriptTextEditor had more things protected than it should have, I made them private.

`get_theme_icon` was clashing with Control's `get_theme_icon`, so I changed it to be more accurate, it gets the icon of the document.

I used the same project for performance in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/115662.

Compared to #115662, I opted to just make them lazy initialized instead of moving them to the ScriptEditor, since its more complex now that Shader Editor is merged with it and needs some of these, and because the main goal is startup performance.
